subject: dsa
title: Permutation in String
summary: A permutation has identical letter counts. Slide a fixed window the size of s1 across s2 and check whether the window's counts match s1's.
problem: Return true if s2 contains a permutation of s1 as a contiguous substring.

steps.caption: Does s2 = eidbaooo contain a permutation of s1 = ab? A permutation has the same letters in any order, so slide a length-2 window and compare counts.
Target counts from s1: a:1, b:1. Window [0..1] = 'ei' — counts don't match.
[2..3] = 'db' — it has a b but no a. No match.
[3..4] = 'ba' — counts b:1, a:1, exactly the target. Match!
'ba' is a permutation of 'ab', found at indices 3-4. Return true.
